specs.title: responsive baseline preserves order and avoids horizontal overflow
keyboard navigation, section targets, and not-found behavior work
long selected lesson titles stay readable without blocking mobile video controls
question draft survives Escape, reopening and client navigation, with isolated courses and local submission
comments validate blank input, render literal text once and persist after reload and stay isolated by course
exam retains answer and current question after closing/navigation, validates submission and keeps the derived result
PDF displays its actual rendered page and accessible text, zooms inside the popup and credits explicit read once
native modal contains keyboard focus, blocks background scroll and restores trigger/scroll under the sticky player
leaderboard derives current progress and level-specific original Arabic encouragement for all level buckets
all required popups fit narrow, tablet, desktop and short landscape viewports with reachable close controls
PDF preview failure keeps readable document text and the original-file alternative inside the popup
media and document payloads wait for intent at 430px
media and document payloads wait for intent at 1440px
video position and genuine completion survive hard reload without duplicate credit
partial exam, submitted score, PDF read, drafts and reset survive reload and reconcile with catalogue
blocked browser storage keeps anonymous flows working with truthful feedback
quota browser storage keeps anonymous flows working with truthful feedback
corrupt browser storage keeps anonymous flows working with truthful feedback
every course has its own readable PDF, playable captioned video and scored assessment
inline media really plays and Wide/fullscreen preserve the mounted video and playback position
switching lessons saves individual positions and does not carry timestamps into another lesson
ended media credits once, updates catalogue, preserves course isolation and returns to selected lesson
mobile sticky player leaves section targets visible and fits a short landscape viewport
progress animates on entry; reduced motion shows the final fill directly
unsupported fullscreen and failed media give truthful recovery without progress credit
